summary: Google's featured snippets favor numbered steps, so add a numbered list near the top of pages where it fits.
questions: How can my docs page show up as a Google featured snippet?

answer_card.title: Numbered lists for featured snippets
answer_card.answer_md: Google builds featured snippets from numbered steps. Where it makes sense, put a numbered list (the procedure or a high-level overview) near the top of the page.
